title: wholesome snappy turkish lotus root kofte
description: a romantic turkish dish featuring crispy lotus root kofte with a peppery kick, perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: mix the ground beef, bulgur, chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, black pepper, and salt in a large bowl until well combined.
add the cornstarch and mix until the mixture is sticky and holds together.
cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 35056.
shape the mixture into small kofte and dust with flour.
deep-fry the kofte until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
drain the kofte on paper towels and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
meanwhile, slice the lotus root into thin rounds and soak in cold water for at least 30 minutes to remove excess starch.
drain the lotus root slices and pat dry with paper towels.
deep-fry the lotus root slices until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
drain the lotus root slices on paper towels and serve with the kofte.
for an extra crispy coating, sprinkle the kofte and lotus root slices with a pinch of cornstarch before deep-frying.
